name: One-on-One
description: A private conversation's themes, agreements and follow-ups.

sections.heading: Themes
sections.instruction: The topics this conversation actually spent time on, in the order of the time spent on them.

sections.heading: Feedback Exchanged
sections.instruction: Feedback given in either direction, stated plainly and without softening or sharpening it. Omit if none was given.

sections.heading: Agreements
sections.instruction: What the two people agreed to, including anything either committed to change.

sections.heading: Follow-ups
sections.instruction: Actions either person owns before the next conversation.
